premise: Ammonite, who can stay down in the lagoon all day, thinks Plesiosaur's popping up — puff! — is a game and follows him down and up until she's dizzy; Spinosaurus on the shore laughs: Plesiosaur breathes air, just like him — so she does the bubbles while he does the puffs.
inspiration: Kipling's 'Just So' 'how-the-X' pattern, answered truly: the reason for all that popping up is a breath of air.
lesson: Friends can play together even when they are made differently.
learning: Plesiosaurs breathed air, so they came up to the surface to take a breath.

en-US.title: Plesiosaur Comes Up for Air
en-US.text: {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} Little Ammonite lived down in the lagoon, and she could stay under the water all day long. {ammonite:face happy} But {plesiosaur:enter} Plesiosaur couldn't. {plesiosaur:live dive} Down he dived, and up he popped. {sfx:puff} PUFF! Down again, up again. {sfx:puff} PUFF! {ammonite:face surprised} [curious] "What's up there?" wondered Ammonite. "Is it a game? I want to play!" {ammonite:go to plesiosaur} So she followed him. Down, up. Down, up. Down, up, {ammonite:spin} until she was spinning like a top. {ammonite:face sad} But however hard she tried, she couldn't make a single puff. {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to shore} Spinosaurus was watching from the shore, and {spinosaurus:live laugh} he laughed and laughed. [warmly] "It isn't a game, little one. He's breathing! Plesiosaur needs air, same as me." {plesiosaur:live nod} Plesiosaur nodded and took a big gulp of it. {ammonite:face happy} "Then you do the puffing," said Ammonite, "and I'll do the bubbles!" {canvas:bubbles} {ammonite:live blow-bubbles hold} {sfx:bubbles} Up they went, blub, blub, blub. [happily] {plesiosaur:face happy} PUFF, went Plesiosaur, up top. Blub, blub, went Ammonite, down below. {spinosaurus:face happy} {spinosaurus:hop x2} And Spinosaurus cheered for them both.

es-ES.title: Plesiosaurio sale a respirar
es-ES.text: {ammonite:enter} {ammonite:go to lagoon} La pequeña Amonites vivía en el fondo de la laguna, y podía pasarse el día entero bajo el agua. {ammonite:face happy} Pero {plesiosaur:enter} Plesiosaurio, no. {plesiosaur:live dive} Se zambullía y, al momento, asomaba otra vez. {sfx:puff} ¡FFFUUU! Abajo, arriba. {sfx:puff} ¡FFFUUU! {ammonite:face surprised} [curious] —¿Qué habrá ahí arriba? —se preguntó Amonites—. ¿Es un juego? ¡Yo también quiero jugar! {ammonite:go to plesiosaur} Y se fue detrás de él. Abajo, arriba. Abajo, arriba. Abajo, arriba, {ammonite:spin} hasta que acabó girando como una peonza. {ammonite:face sad} Pero por mucho que lo intentaba, no le salía ni un resoplido. {spinosaurus:enter} {spinosaurus:go to shore} Espinosaurio lo miraba todo desde la orilla, y {spinosaurus:live laugh} se reía a carcajadas. [warmly] —No es un juego, pequeña. ¡Está respirando! Plesiosaurio necesita aire, igual que yo. {plesiosaur:live nod} Plesiosaurio asintió y tomó una buena bocanada. {ammonite:face happy} —Pues tú pones los resoplidos —dijo Amonites—, ¡y yo las burbujas! {canvas:bubbles} {ammonite:live blow-bubbles hold} {sfx:bubbles} Y allá subieron, blup, blup, blup. [happily] {plesiosaur:face happy} ¡FFFUUU!, hacía Plesiosaurio, arriba. Blup, blup, hacía Amonites, abajo. {spinosaurus:face happy} {spinosaurus:hop x2} Y Espinosaurio los animaba a los dos.
